scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:test
scripts.web: npm run brand:sync -- --skip-images && npm run web --workspace apps/mobile -- --clear
scripts.iphone: cd apps/mobile && npx expo run:ios --device --configuration Release
scripts.web:real: cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=supabase npm run web --workspace apps/mobile -- --clear
scripts.phone:real: cd apps/mobile && cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=supabase npx expo start --tunnel --clear
